links.outcome: Understandability and actionability of chatbot patient information on urologic telesurgery (PEMAT-P)
links.effect: PEMAT-P understandability exceeded 70% for both (overall 79.7% Gemini vs 78.1% ChatGPT); actionability uniformly low, only Gemini met 70% in the prospective domain.
links.quote: PEMAT-P understandability uniformly exceeded 70% for both platforms: prospective 80.0% versus 71.7%; technical 80.1% versus 79.8%; recovery 79.2% versus 80.1%; other 79.2% versus 81.3%; overall 79.7% versus 78.1% (Fig. 2).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of two commercial LLMs (ChatGPT and Gemini) answering patient-facing questions on urologic telesurgery evaluated with DISCERN and PEMAT-P tools, without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
